replay_results.text: Savills Auctions Home Commercial Residential Nottingham Leeds Login / Register View Document Basket Lot 14 Land at Moor Lane, Rickmansworth, Hertfordshire Guide Price £100,000+ Please log in to view Legal Pack and Special Conditions Map SC10 Rickmansworth 2pg Land at Moor Lane, Rickmansworth, Hertfordshire  WD3 1LQ •   18.62 Hectares (46    Acres) Freehold Agricultural Land within the M25 •   Currently    let to Secure Agricultural Tenant Producing: £1,035    pa •   Attractive Riverside  Location •   Designated  as Greenbelt and a 'Wildlife Site' On Instructions    from Tarmac Location Rickmansworth,    with a population of approximately 15,000, is an affluent commuter town in the Three    Rivers district of Hertfordshire. The town is served by excellent transport links    with the M25 (Junctions 17 and 18) being approximately 3 miles away, via the A4145,    A404 and A412. Direct rail links to London (Marylebone) are provided by Chiltern    Railways, with journey times of approximately 20 minutes. The    property is situated to the north of Moor Lane (A4145), to the south of the River    Colne and adjacent to the Grand Union Canal. Several residential properties are    located along the frontage of Moor Lane, where it runs adjacent to the property,    and Rickmansworth Public Golf Course is situated just to the south. The exclusive    Moor Park residential estate and Golf Course is situated to the south. Description The    property comprises an irregular shaped parcel of rough pasture land of approximately    18.62 hectares (46 acres). The site also contains two concrete pillboxes which are    part of a 'stop line' constructed all along the Colne Valley after the evacuation    from Dunkirk in World War II. The site area has been taken from Promap. Tenure Freehold. Planning The    site is designated as Greenbelt and a 'Local Wildlife Site', the latter being defined    as a site of 'substantive nature conservation importance'. For further information    please contact the Three Rivers District Council on Tel: (01923) 776611 or visit    their website at www.threerivers.gov.uk Tenancy    & Accommodation The    property is offered subject to a written tenancy agreement under the Agricultural    Holdings Act (1986) which gives the tenant security of tenure (1). The tenant is    Mr Brazier, a local farmer and the current rent reserved is £1,035 per annum.    The fishing rights to the river are reserved by Kodak Angling Society into perpetuity. The    land will be sold with restrictions on future use, please have regard to the Special    Conditions of Sale for further information. Note (1) Prospective purchasers are    advised to seek independent legal advice with regard to the Agricultural Holdings    Act (1986). VAT Value    Added Tax is not applicable to this lot.
